coverage: Read every line of client/src/pages/Login.tsx:1-737, client/src/pages/Menu.tsx:1-815, client/src/pages/MyAttendance.tsx:1-378, client/src/pages/Orders.tsx:1-774. Cross-checked server PUT /api/orders/:id (server/routes.ts ~2577), storage.updateOrder and shared/orderMutation.ts orderUpdateAllowlist for reachability of the Orders status select. Did not read child components (PaymentTag, PaymentMethodDialog, DueSettleDialog, DayPicker, AddMenuItemModal, CategoriesTab, printGateway) beyond their call sites.

findings.title: Status dropdown un-cancels a cancelled order (and can hide/resurrect dues) with no PIN
findings.detail: Every row, including cancelled and paid orders, renders an enabled status Select. Only the 'cancelled' option is disabled; pending/preparing/ready/served/delivered stay selectable on a cancelled row. onStatusChange sends PUT /api/orders/:id {status}, which the server accepts for any requireAuth session (orderUpdateAllowlist includes status; storage.updateOrder has no WHERE guard on current status). Cancellation is a PIN-gated, audited deviation that also reversed inventory, freed the table and completed KOT tickets.
findings.failure_scenario: A staff-tier session opens Order History, finds a cancelled order (status cancelled, paymentStatus pending) and picks 'served'. The order becomes served+pending, i.e. a Due (isDueOrder), reappears in the Pay-Later/dues totals and the Tables Due pill, and no longer counts as cancelled in reports — without a PIN or audit row, and with stock already reversed. Conversely picking 'pending' on a served+unpaid due drops it out of every Due list (isDueOrder requires served), hiding a customer's debt; picking 'pending' on a paid order puts it back into ACTIVE_ORDER_STATUSES on Live View.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable the Select entirely for cancelled orders and for paid orders (render a read-only badge), and do not allow moving a served+unpaid due back to an active status from here. Mirror on the server: in PUT /api/orders/:id refuse status changes when the current status is cancelled or the order is settled, and refuse status='cancelled' (must go through /cancel).
findings.reason: Confirmed: Orders.tsx Select disables only 'cancelled'; PUT /api/orders/:id (routes.ts:2577) is requireAuth, orderUpdateAllowlist includes status, storage.updateOrder has no status/payment WHERE guard and writes no audit row. Staff role defaults include /orders (shared/pageAccess.ts), and the API is reachable by any session anyway. Cancelled->served creates a phantom due; served+pending->pending hides a due. No server guard found.

findings.title: Bulk 'Change %' rejects negative percentages, so prices can never be reduced in bulk
findings.detail: handleBulkPrice rejects `val < 0` for both modes. That check is right for 'Set ₹' but in percent mode a negative value is the only way to express a decrease (factor = 1 + val/100).
findings.failure_scenario: Admin selects 20 items and enters -10 in 'Change %' to cut prices by 10%; the page toasts 'Invalid value' and nothing changes, so every item must be edited individually.
findings.suggested_fix: In percent mode allow val > -100 (reject only val <= -100 or NaN); keep the >= 0 check for fixed mode.
findings.reason: Confirmed val<0 rejected in both modes (Menu.tsx:207); input has no min so -10 is typeable and gets 'Invalid value'. Real but a missing capability with a workaround (per-item edit), not data corruption.

findings.title: Percent bulk price update is non-atomic; a retry after partial failure compounds the change
findings.detail: Percent mode fires one POST /api/menu/bulk-update per item via Promise.all. If any request fails, the catch only toasts 'Price update failed' — no invalidation, selection kept, and the already-applied items are not reported. rawItems still holds the old prices for the items that succeeded.
findings.failure_scenario: Admin applies +10% to 15 items; 12 succeed, 3 fail on a network blip. The toast says it failed and the grid is not refreshed. After the next refetch (or immediately, if the admin reselects and retries) the admin taps Update again: the 12 already-raised items get a second +10% (≈+21% total) while the 3 failed ones get +10%.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Promise.allSettled, invalidate ['/api/menu?all=true'] in all cases, and report exactly which items failed (or send one bulk request with per-item updates handled transactionally on the server).
findings.reason: Confirmed Promise.all per-item requests with catch that neither invalidates nor reports partial success. Immediate retry does NOT compound (rawItems still holds old prices so the same target values are re-sent); compounding only happens after a later refetch, when the admin can see the new prices. Partial-failure reporting gap is real; severity lower than claimed.

findings.title: Login card keys use bare id, but staff-member and user cards share the id space
findings.detail: GET /api/staff-members returns unified cards tagged kind 'staff'|'user'; CLAUDE.md notes users and staffMembers share integer ids. Both card grids (lines 449 and 646) key on s.id only.
findings.failure_scenario: Staff member id 4 and a manager account id 4 both have mobile cards: React sees duplicate keys, warns, and on any re-render/reorder can reuse the wrong element (stale animation/initial state, or a card dropped from reconciliation).
findings.reason: Confirmed both grids key={s.id}; GET /api/staff-members returns unified cards of both kinds (CLAUDE.md Mobile name-card login) whose ids share an integer space, so duplicate keys are reachable. Cosmetic/reconciliation impact only.

findings.title: Cancelled tab content exists but has no TabsTrigger
findings.detail: TabsContent is rendered for 'cancelled' but the TabsList only lists all/pending/preparing/ready/served/delivered, so the cancelled-orders view is unreachable (and its OrderList still filters on every render).
findings.failure_scenario: A manager wants to see only cancelled orders in Order History; there is no tab for it, they must scroll the All list.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'cancelled' to the TabsList array, or drop the unreachable TabsContent.
findings.reason: Confirmed TabsList omits 'cancelled' while TabsContent for it is rendered; unreachable view. Cancelled orders are reported in Reports -> Cancelled Orders, so impact is dead UI only.

findings.title: Reprint Bill failure silently shows an unprintable text preview with no error
findings.detail: On a non-2xx /api/print/bill (e.g. 503 settings unavailable, 500) reprintBill just opens the text preview, which CLAUDE.md says cannot be printed; no toast explains the failure. res.json() is also called before the ok check, so a non-JSON error body throws into the same silent path.
findings.failure_scenario: Settings are briefly unavailable (503); staff tap Reprint Bill, get a preview modal and assume it is the bill, with no indication the print request failed.
findings.suggested_fix: On !res.ok toast the server's message (describeApiError) before/instead of the preview; parse JSON defensively.
findings.reason: Confirmed: !res.ok branch and catch both call showBillPreview() with no toast; res.json() precedes ok check so a non-JSON body lands in catch. Billing.tsx was fixed to toast on failure per CLAUDE.md but this page was not.

findings.title: Expanded row shows 'Loading…' spinner forever when the detail fetch fails or the order has no items
findings.detail: The items area keys only on items.length === 0, not on the query's loading/error state.
findings.failure_scenario: An order whose items were all cancelled (items: []) or whose /api/orders/:id fetch 404s/500s shows a perpetual spinner instead of 'No items' or an error.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the query's isLoading/isError and render 'No items' when loaded and empty.
findings.reason: Confirmed: items derives from detail?.items || [] and spinner is shown whenever items.length===0, with no isLoading/isError check, so a failed fetch or an empty-item order spins forever.
